sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Meng Hua, Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil (莫华) is a story encounter in Mount Soulrend & endgame, found at Peak of Mount Soulrend - true ending checkpoint. Beating it yields The Lady's Fan.

sections.title: Where to Find the Meng Hua, Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil (莫华)
sections.content:
Location: Peak of Mount Soulrend - true ending checkpoint.

Appears in: Mount Soulrend & endgame.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Meng Hua, Merciful Lady of the Blossom Veil (莫华)
sections.content:
What works

  • Normal-ending final boss - attack during the openings rather than trying to out-trade her.
  • Her fan attacks cover wide arcs; the safe window is after the sweep, not during it.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 57 of 60 in the progression order, in Mount Soulrend & endgame. Before it: Herald of the Veil. After it: Zuo Shang, The True Long. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
